class.name: VehicleAerodynamicsData
class.brief_description: A resource that defines aerodynamic properties: drag, downforce, and yaw damping.
class.description: VehicleAerodynamicsData is a [Resource] that configures the vehicle's aerodynamic forces. Drag opposes forward motion, downforce increases tire grip at speed, and yaw damping provides high-speed rotational stability without fighting low-speed maneuverability.

members.member: Aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd). Higher values increase air resistance at speed.
Downforce coefficient. Combined with drag coefficient to produce aerodynamic downforce that pushes the tires into the ground at speed.

Yaw damping coefficient. Applies a torque opposing yaw rotation proportional to [code]mass × angular_velocity × |angular_velocity|[/code]. Higher values stabilize the car at speed without affecting low-speed turning.
